import re,os,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==8 or seen[i][j]: continue
            comp=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cols=set([g[i][j]])
            stack=[(i,j)]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop()
                for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc]!=8:
                        seen[nr][nc]=True; comp.append((nr,nc)); cols.add(g[nr][nc])
            color=[x for x in cols if x!=0]
            if not color: continue
            color=color[0]
            pts=[(r,c) for r,c in comp if g[r][c]==color]
            r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); c0=min(p[1] for p in pts)
            r1=max(p[0] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
            pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
            h,w=len(pat),len(pat[0])
            for r,c in comp:
                out[r][c]=pat[(r-r0)%h][(c-c0)%w]
    return out
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
res=transform(d)
print(res==o, json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
